name: KingRoyal.Media
note: Rating note: KingRoyal.Media is a sports-news website; Mundo Deportivo (EFE) describes it as a Turkish international digital sports-news platform and Baskonia's main shirt sponsor from November 2025 (two seasons, to 2026-27). Its own site says it is operated by Kingroyal Media Company LTD, based in Cyprus. iGamingTR (a betting-trade outlet, Jan 2026) reports unverified industry claims linking the brand to the Turkish betting network Meritking; no regulator finding was found, and betting/regulatory matters do not pass the rating test in any case (see pull request). Proposed 'Nothing found'; a maintainer sets the tier.
